pageCache.text:
Head of School's Welcome
Driven by a determination to create welcoming schools for the local community, where every person thrives, makes excellent progress and succeeds.
Head of School's Welcome
Welcome to ORION Ravensworth Primary School
Welcome to Orion Ravensworth
Welcome, and thank you for taking the time to find out about our school.
At Orion Ravensworth, we believe in educating the whole child. Our children are known, valued and encouraged to shine, and from the moment they join us in Reception, they become part of a warm, nurturing family that is proud of who we are and of the community we serve.
Running through everything we do is a golden thread of trust, kindness and endeavour. You will see it in our classrooms and on our playground, and in the way our children speak to one another and to visitors. It is woven through our curriculum from Reception all the way to Year 6, shaping how children learn as well as what they learn. We want every child to trust in themselves and others, to show kindness as a natural habit, and to give their very best effort, knowing that endeavour is always celebrated.
Our expectations are high, for every child and in every subject. We believe children rise to the standards we set for them, and we support them with well-planned teaching, rich experiences and a culture in which it is safe to try, to make mistakes and to keep going. The result is children who make excellent progress and leave us as confident, curious and responsible young people, ready for the next stage of their lives.
None of this would be possible without our amazing staff. Every member of our team, from teachers and teaching assistants to office, kitchen and site staff, is deeply committed to our pupils. They know every child as an individual, celebrate their successes, support them through their challenges and go the extra mile to make sure each one feels safe, happy and ready to learn. Their dedication, care and high aspirations for our children are the heart of our school, and I am immensely proud to work alongside them.
Learning here doesn't stop at the classroom door. Every child has the opportunity to go on at least one trip every half term, so learning comes to life through real places, real people and real experiences. Whether children are exploring a museum, visiting a place of worship or investigating the world around them, these moments spark curiosity, deepen understanding and create memories that last long after the visit itself. Alongside our clubs, events and pupil leadership opportunities, they are a big part of what makes life at Orion Ravensworth so special. Above all, we are a community. Parents, carers, staff, governors and local partners work together, and our children are at the heart of it. Your support makes a real difference, and we are proud of the strong relationships that make our school such a happy place to learn and to work.
I warmly invite you to explore our website, take our virtual tour and, if you can, come and see us for yourself. We would love to welcome you. I'm excited to welcome you to Ravensworth and show you around our wonderful school. We hope you'll see just how special our school is with a warm, family-like atmosphere where everyone feels valued. We truly believe Ravensworth is the best place to be, and we can't wait to share it with you!
Mrs K JamesHead of School

Personal Development
Driven by a determination to create welcoming schools for the local community, where every person thrives, makes excellent progress and succeeds.
Personal Development
At Ravensworth Primary School, our ethos and approach support the personal development of every pupil.
A child’s primary years are essential to developing their own identity, confidence, and aspirations for the future. In addition to academic success, we ensure children are given opportunities for personal development, throughout our curriculum and beyond. We play an active role in preparing children for their future so they can go on to engage positively in society.
Children here are nurtured and encouraged to develop positive attributes such as integrity, resilience and acceptance, as well as developing an understanding of British values, preparing them for life in modern Britain, and indeed, the world. Equality and diversity are promoted and celebrated, and we are very proud of a curriculum which equips our children with the knowledge, skills and understanding to lead happy, safe and healthy lives whilst enabling them to develop their talents and strive for their goals.
Our personal development curriculum provides significant opportunities for pupils to engage in 6 key areas, with wellbeing featuring as an overarching priority.
Character Development
Character development at Ravensworth is a key feature of our offer. In this ever-changing world, the development of a strong, resilient character is an unchanging requirement. We provide our children with the opportunity to develop those personal strengths that will enable them to go out into the world with the confidence, resilience and self-belief needed to negotiate the challenges and opportunities that life will bring. We provide a rich context in which we educate, support and challenge children in applying these personal strengths, so that they can act with wisdom to achieve the best outcomes academically and socially. Our ethos of ‘educating the whole child’ is integral to character development and we are passionate about developing children with a well-rounded character. Our initiatives run through PSHE lessons, assemblies and a wide range of SMSC opportunities.

pageCache.text:
British Values
Driven by a determination to create welcoming schools for the local community, where every person thrives, makes excellent progress and succeeds.
British Values
Promoting British Values at Ravensworth Primary School
At Ravensworth Primary School, we are committed to promoting the fundamental British Values of Democracy, The Rule of Law, Individual Liberty, Mutual Respect and Tolerance of Those with Different Faiths and Beliefs. These values are embedded across our curriculum and wider school life helping to prepare our pupils to become respectful, responsible, and active citizens in modern Britain.
Children are encouraged to express their views and make choices through school council elections, pupil voice activities, and class discussions. They learn that their opinions matter and that they can make a difference in shaping school life.
We teach the importance of rules and laws through our behaviour policy, class charters, and everyday routines. Pupils learn the reasons behind rules, how they protect us, and the consequences when they are broken, promoting a safe and orderly environment.
We support children in developing confidence to make safe, respectful choices and to understand their rights and responsibilities. Through PSHE, e-safety, and enrichment activities, pupils are encouraged to explore their interests and express their individuality in a supportive setting.
Respect is at the heart of our school values. Pupils learn to work cooperatively, listen to others, and treat everyone with kindness. We celebrate achievements difference, and shared successes, fostering a strong sense of community.
Tolerance of Those with Different Faiths and Beliefs
Our diverse curriculum reflects the multi-faith society in which we live. Through RE, assemblies, themed days, and visits, pupils learn about a range of religions and worldviews. We promote understanding, challenge stereotypes, and encourage open mindedness and curiosity.
These values are not taught in isolation, but are part of the inclusive and respectful culture we promote every day at Ravensworth Primary School.

About Our School
Driven by a determination to create welcoming schools for the local community, where every person thrives, makes excellent progress and succeeds.
About Our School
Welcome to Orion Ravensworth!
Orion Ravensworth is a warm, nurturing, and inclusive community where our vision to educate the whole child is at the heart of everything we do. as part of the Orion Education multi-academy trust, we are proud to work collaboratively with other schools to raise aspirations and deliver the highest standards of education. Our core values of Kindness, Trust and Endeavour are the golden thread that runs through our ethos, shaping our curriculum, culture and relationships.
We believe in the potential of every child and are committed to providing a learning journey that is both challenging and rewarding. Through inspiration, motivation, and support, we empower our pupils to aim high, grow in confidence and develop a lifelong love of learning. We take great pride in our school, the community we serve, and the meaningful work we do together.
At Orion Ravensworth, education goes beyond the classroom. We offer a holistic approach that nurtures every aspect of a child's development. London becomes our second classroom, providing exciting opportunities for immersive, real-world learning experiences in one of the world's most dynamic cities. Closer to home, our school allotment and outdoor classroom support our commitment to outdoor learning and environmental education, offering hands-on experiences that bring the natural world to life.
we encourage children to explore their interests and talents through a wide range of after-school cubs, fostering creativity, teamwork, and personal growth. Our enrichment programmes are designed to develop well-rounded, resilient individuals equipped with the knowledge, skills , and experiences they need to thrive - both now now and in the future.

Breakfast Club
Driven by a determination to create welcoming schools for the local community, where every person thrives, makes excellent progress and succeeds.
Breakfast Club
Our Breakfast Club runs from 7:30am to 8:35am every term time day. Children are offered a wide range of activities to enjoy and extend their learning experiences, including arts and crafts, ICT, sports, games and role play.
Children enjoy a variety of breakfasts, including cereal, bagels and a variety of juices. The planning of activities is led by the children to very much reflect their interests and tastes.
The Breakfast Club is available to all our children from Reception to Year 6. Sessions from 7:30-8:35am including activities and breakfast, cost £4 per child. If an emergency session is need and a place is available, the cost will be £6.
An admission form must be completed prior to your child attending the club to ensure their dietary and medical needs are met. Admission forms may be downloaded here and are also available from the school office.

Reading at Orion Ravensworth
Driven by a determination to create welcoming schools for the local community, where every person thrives, makes excellent progress and succeeds.
Reading at Orion Ravensworth
Every child should become a confident, fluent reader who enjoys reading
Our Approach to Reading
At Orion Ravensworth, we believe reading is at the heart of everything we do.
From the very start of school, we help children to become confident, fluent readers who enjoy reading and use it to succeed across all subjects.
We carefully choose high-quality books that inspire children, build their understanding of the world and help them to think and communicate clearly.
Our approach to reading is well planned and consistent across all year groups, so that every child makes strong progress.
We want children not only to learn to read well, but to develop a lifelong love of reading, discovering new ideas, people and possibilities along the way.
What Reading Looks Like at Orion Ravensworth
📚 Books are carefully matched to each child’s stage
🗓️ Reading is taught every day in every class
🛟 We support children to catch up if they fall behind
Early Reading (EYFS & Key Stage 1)
We give children a strong start in reading through:
Daily phonics teaching
Books matched to the sounds children know
Regular opportunities to practise reading aloud
Close support to help every child succeed
Reading in Key Stage 2
As children progress, they continue to develop through:
Children learn to understand, explain and enjoy what they read.
Daily reading lessons
Whole-class reading of high-quality texts
Opportunities to discuss and explore books
Structured support where needed
Reading for Pleasure
At Orion Ravensworth, we want all children to develop a love of reading.
We promote this through:
📖 Daily reading time
📚 Inviting reading spaces
⭐ Book recommendations – School Cannon
🎤 Opportunities to talk about books
📅 Reading events and celebrations
How We Promote Reading for Pleasure at Orion RAVENSWORTH
Reading for pleasure starts early at Orion Ravensworth - from stories and rhymes in our Little Stars Nursery, to confident, enthusiastic readers by Year 6.
We make reading a joyful, everyday part of school life.
How we bring reading to life:
📖 Daily stories & class reads — books at the heart of every day
🎯 Choice matters — children pick books they love
🌍 Diverse books — reflecting the world and building empathy
🏫 Inviting libraries — great books, easy to access
👩‍🏫 Reading role models — staff share their love of reading
👫 Reading together — with friends, staff and families
⏰ Stories every day — time to enjoy a class novel
🎉 Celebrate reading — from comics to classics
🔗 Real-world links — connecting books to life
Supporting Every Child
We ensure every child succeeds in reading by:
Identifying children who need extra support early
Providing additional reading opportunities
Offering small group or one-to-one support
Regularly checking progress
Reading at Home
Parents and carers can help by:
Reading with your child every day
Listening to them read regularly
Talking about books together
Encouraging a love of reading
What Makes Reading Special at Orion Ravensworth
At Orion Ravensworth, reading is more than a routine — it’s a shared experience that brings our school community together ❤️
🌅 Calm, purposeful reading routines — creating space to enjoy and focus at key points in the day
🗣️ Rich book talk — children confidently discuss, recommend and reflect on what they read
🧠 Deep thinking — books are used to spark curiosity, questions and meaningful discussion
🤝 Strong reading community — families, staff and pupils all play a role in supporting reading
🎭 Bringing stories to life — through expression, performance and creativity
🌈 Every reader valued — celebrating each child’s unique reading journey and interests
🏅 Pupil leadership — reading ambassadors champion books across the school
🔄 Reading woven through learning — connections made across subjects and experiences
Leadership of Reading
Reading is a priority at Orion Ravensworth.
Reading is led by Ms. K James
Staff receive regular training
Part of Orion Education Trust
We are proud to be part of Orion Education Trust.
Our approach to reading is aligned with the trust-wide commitment to ensuring that every child becomes a fluent, confident reader and enjoys reading.
